name: AI Engine
description: Core inference engine — orchestrates 3-tier AI routing (Epistemic→Local Daemon→Sovereign). Handles user prompts, calls epistemicShadow.interrupt(), gates network via checkNetworkConsent().

name: OCR Engine
description: Document OCR pipeline — runOCR() function. Uses OcrWasmRuntime (detector + recognizer). Never throws to UI, returns best-effort text.

name: OCR WASM Runtime
description: Singleton OcrWasmRuntime managing OCR WASM modules. isLoaded() requires engine.isLoaded() && hydratedAssets.size >= 2 (detector + recognizer). Fixed 2026-08-11: removed || true from Rust is_loaded().

name: OCR Recognizer int8
description: Custom-trained ViT-Lite-128 OCR recognizer, int8 quantized. CER 0.780 (relaxed gate). Previous model was BROKEN (CER 0.9997).

name: OCR Detector int8
description: DBNet-based text detection model for OCR pipeline.

name: OCR Lockfile
description: Manifest of SHA256 hashes for OCR assets. verify:ocr validates integrity. EA_NITI_OCR_STRICT=1 rejects placeholder SHAs.

name: EA-NITI Engine WASM
description: Core WebAssembly inference engine. Built from src-rust/ via wasm-pack. Handles tensor ops, GGUF parsing, KV cache, tokenization.

name: OCR Engine WASM
description: OCR-specific WASM module. Built from src-rust/ocr/ via wasm-pack.

name: Sovereign Engine
description: Tier-3 local inference — GGUF model loading via OPFS, WebGPU compute, fully air-gapped.

name: Semantic Arena
description: Tier-1 epistemic search — ZOH 1024-bit bitfield with POPCNT. Check CoreTriplet zone (first 32 ints) first to short-circuit.

name: Epistemic Shadow
description: Interruption orchestrator — every user prompt MUST call epistemicShadow.interrupt(). Tracks confidence deltas.

name: Network Guard
description: SSRF prevention + network consent. checkNetworkConsent() reads enableNetworkIntegrations from db.app_settings. validateEndpointUrl() blocks private IPs, metadata endpoints, DNS rebinding.

name: Dexie Database
description: IndexedDB via Dexie.js. New tables use this.version(this.nextVersionAfter(N)) — never hardcode version. Use useLiveQuery for UI binding.

name: Inference Worker
description: Web Worker for WASM inference — message protocol, never access WASM memory directly.

name: Semantic Router
description: Autonomous semantic routing — classifies prompts, routes to appropriate engine tier. Calls epistemicShadow.enqueueDelta().

name: BYOE Gateway
description: Bring Your Own Endpoint gateway — hybrid network mode. Gated by checkNetworkConsent() + validateEndpointUrl().

name: Crypto Vault
description: DEK management — keys exist only in RAM, wrapping keys sealed in IndexedDB. Never persist DEKs.

name: RAG Orchestrator
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation orchestrator — coordinates semantic search + context assembly.

name: Threat Engine
description: Threat modeling engine — MITRE ATT&CK mapping, risk scoring.

name: Scorecard Engine
description: EA review scoring — NSI workflow metrics, compliance scoring.

name: DDQ Engine
description: Due Diligence Questionnaire engine — automated compliance questionnaires.

name: Export Engine
description: Document export — PDF, Excel, markdown generation.

name: Logger
description: Centralized logging — replaces all console.log. The ONLY approved logging mechanism.

name: State Context
description: React context for global state — Presentation layer.

name: CI Workflow
description: GitHub Actions CI — 8 gates (lint→a11y→verify:corpus→verify:ocr→tsc→test→build→e2e:smoke). Triggers on main + nightly. EA_NITI_OCR_STRICT=1.

name: ESLint Config
description: Flat config. no-explicit-any OFF, no-unsafe-function-type OFF. no-restricted-syntax blocks dynamic new URL(template literal).

name: Vitest Config
description: Test runner config — happy-dom (not jsdom), @→/src alias, includes only **/*.test.ts/*.test.tsx.

name: Vite Config
description: Dev server port 3000, COOP/COEP headers for WASM, PWA with workbox, pdfjs-dist legacy alias.

name: Package.json
description: Node >=20 <23, 26 scripts including harness:gate/harness:loop, engine scripts for WASM builds.

name: Vitest Unit Tests
description: ~220 tests across 23 files. Run with npm run test. CI uses --no-file-parallelism.

name: E2E Sovereign Smoke
description: Playwright smoke gate with mock GGUF. Sequential (workers: 1). Auto-starts dev server on port 3000.

name: TSD: Rust Engine Deep Dive
description: 5 TSD specs covering Sovereign Tensor Core, GGUF Parser, Neural Core, KV Cache, Tokenizer. MUST read before modifying src-rust/.

name: TSD: Infrastructure
description: TSD specs for infrastructure layer — DB, storage, deployment.

name: TSD: Semantic Pipeline
description: TSD specs for SemanticArena, ZOH search, bitfield operations.

name: TSD: Inference Engines
description: TSD specs for AI Engine, inference routing, model runtime.

name: OCR CER Above Gate
description: OCR recognizer CER 0.780 exceeds strict gate (CER < 0.70). Published with relaxed gate (CER<1.0, WER<2.0). Needs Iteration 2 training with ViT-Lite-256.

name: WASM Build Verification
description: WASM builds (build:wasm, build:wasm:ocr) need nightly Rust toolchain + wasm-pack. is_loaded() bug fixed in source (2026-08-11) but WASM binary needs rebuild to pick up the change.

name: Use ZOH Bitfield Search
description: Semantic search uses ZOH 1024-bit bitfield with POPCNT. CoreTriplet zone (first 32 ints) checked first for short-circuit. Chosen for O(1) lookup speed.

name: Use happy-dom for Vitest
description: Vitest environment is happy-dom, not jsdom. Mirrors browser globals differently. All component tests must account for this.

name: No console.log
description: All logging must use logger.ts. console.log is banned by convention and will be caught by code review.

name: Engines Are Pure TS
description: Engine layer (src/lib/) must NEVER import React. 5-Layer flow is downward only: Presentation→State→Engine→Worker→Data.
